purpose: Compare the larger nstates GPU workload against a single-process CPU loop with matching nstates.
preconditions: reports/tlul_fifo_sync_large_workload_scaling.json exists when CPU/GPU comparison fields are requested

allowed_claims: single-process CPU loop wall time for nstates 32, 128, and 512
GPU batched throughput for nstates 32, 128, and 512
CPU/GPU throughput ratio for this seed and gate shape
non_claims: not a full RTL application throughput claim
no target-breadth claim because only tlul_fifo_sync is exercised
steps remain fixed at 1 because CPU exact-loop timing does not yet model repeated eval steps
comparison_policy.next_precision_step: add repeated-step CPU semantics or move to a second seed if large nstates still does not show a GPU win
